notes.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place, AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After all these months of intense work (and some bumps in the road), we’re really excited to announce the release of [i]Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place[/i]! 

We wanted to thank you all for supporting us until this very big day.

We put our heart into this new episode, so we really hope you enjoy it.

If you find any bugs (we hope not), please let us know in the forums/comments so we can fix them ASAP.

Thank you <3!

Octavi & Susanna

PS: You can get it 10% off on launch week, so… what are you waiting for? ;)
